newsitem.title: USA: American Disposal Services names Lavey CFO.
newsitem.headline: American Disposal Services names Lavey CFO.

text.p: American Disposal Services Inc said Monday it named Stephen Lavey as vice president and chief financial officer.
Lavey replaces Scott Flamm. Prior to joining American Disposal, Lavey was with BankAmerica Corp as vice president, environmental services lending group.

Separately, American Disposal, a regional, non-hazardous solid waste services company, said it acquired three companies in Ohio, one in Missouri and one in Massachusetts, bringing to 36 its total acquisitions since January 1993.

In Ohio, the company acquired certain assets of Rumpke Waste of Ohio. It also acquired Bowers Phase II Inc and Allied Waste Systems Inc. In Missouri, American Disposal acquired Sparky's and in Massachusetts, the assets of A-1 Container Services.
The company also said its Livingston Landfill in Pontiac, Ill. will increase long-term volume by an additional 700 tons per day, under the terms of a recently signed contract.

President Richard De Young said, "These acquisitions and the increase in contracted volume at Livingston Landfill should collectively add over $9 million in annualized revenue. And, our acquisition pipeline continues to remain full."

American Disposal provides solid waste collection, transfer and disposal services with operations in Illinois, Missouri, Kansas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island and Massachusetts.
